findings.detail: The actual int descriptor is saved and HeldUnvalidated established before validation helpers. Successful fd/name observations precede VerifiedHeld promotion. Failed validation retains the saved descriptor and returns the distinct infrastructure pair {-2,7104}; no negative native open is invented.

The unchanged engine rejects OPEN<-1 before authoritative recording, stays ActiveIncomplete, returns AC_INCOMPLETE and exposes no unfinished payload. Prepared callback output is not proof of caller recording or public completion. A future {-1,7104} control instead records ordinary failure and completes without follow-up file callbacks.

UnknownEntered precedes actual close entry, and only actual raw0 yields ClosedReturned. A returned error remains UnknownAfterCloseReturn. Cleanup permits only still-held unvalidated/verified custody once. The unused CloseEntered enum is correctly excluded from observed-state claims. No actual native close failure or missing return is claimed.

Final text now distinguishes provider freeze after ac_run/before external cleanup from the child envelope written after both. Normal exit0 and parent exact-size pread remain separate acceptance evidence; the child cannot acknowledge its own report write. Abnormal/nonzero exits supply no completed accepted-envelope proof.

The current parent requires creation_identity_available, which refused validation never sets. The future independent raw-identity receipt must preserve genuine successful fd/name query identities for checked parent observation without falsely promoting accepted creation or VerifiedHeld.

All three controls are proposed only. Report-provenance corruption preserves an independent unmodified identity receipt and actual native calls; refusal normalization changes only the prepared domain; omitted eligible cleanup truthfully reports no actual close and treats process-exit closure solely as containment. No control licenses unknown-token operations or weakens path/token checks. Dedicated composite oracles and matrix counts remain for a later plan.

The final README correctly calls the two per-mode repeat executions repeat-case executions, not two distinct selectors. Historical 40 children, 42 ordinary calls and two suppressed repeats are separate from this source review, which executes zero new cases. Existing native-result/control distinctions and finite observed fd3/close0 limits are maintained.

The complete helper is a narrow textual adaptation of the prior source-only retainer: new document/status/directory and review-input labels, with baseline_commit only. It retains nofollow regular local sources, checks exact pins and line spans, creates exclusive new files, closes input/artifact inventories and projects a sanitized result. It imports no subprocess/compiler/native-provider or prior executable helper; no script was imported or invoked during this review.

All 25 declared reused file byte lengths and hashes match current retained originals; all 29 anchor bounds resolve within their pinned sources and selected semantic excerpts support the stated boundary claims. Whole frozen engine/header/readers are reused. This primitive source inspection is not a replay of predecessor machine-code, runtime or audit procedures.
